sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 在太空中的七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费者产品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60份超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最好的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用不同的起始词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢一锅出的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 现在订阅可享受特别优惠，网址是nytimes.com/subscribe。

sentences.en: My name is Andrew Kramer.
sentences.zh: 我是安德鲁·克莱默。

sentences.en: I'm a reporter for The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的一名记者。

sentences.en: I'm standing on the highway where Ukrainian troops are moving tanks and armored vehicles into Russia.
sentences.zh: 我正站在高速公路上，乌克兰军队正从这里将坦克和装甲车开进俄罗斯。

sentences.en: Every few minutes we have tanks, trucks with soldiers, rumbling past and in the direction of Russia.
sentences.zh: 每隔几分钟，我们就能看到坦克和载着士兵的卡车隆隆驶过，朝着俄罗斯的方向前进。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Ukraine sliced through the border area, pushed through minefields and thinly manned defenses, and has been pressing deeper into Russia.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰切入了边境地区，突破了雷区和防守薄弱的防线，并一直在向俄罗斯腹地推进。

sentences.en: When Ukraine's military crossed over into Russia two weeks ago, it appeared at first to be a largely symbolic gesture.
sentences.zh: 两周前，当乌克兰军队越境进入俄罗斯时，起初这看起来主要是一种象征性的姿态。

sentences.en: But in the time since, it's emerged as a defining moment in the two-year-old war.
sentences.zh: 但在此之后，它已成为这场持续两年战争中的决定性时刻。

sentences.en: This is the first major military incursion into Russia since World War II.
sentences.zh: 这是自二战以来首次对俄罗斯进行的大规模军事入侵。

sentences.en: Today, Andrew Kramer on what's behind the audacious Ukrainian operation and Anton Trojanovsky on how Russia's response could reshape the conflict.
sentences.zh: 今天，安德鲁·克莱默将讲述这场大胆的乌克兰行动背后的原因，安东·特罗亚诺夫斯基将分析俄罗斯的反应如何重塑这场冲突。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, August 21St.
sentences.zh: 今天是8月21日，星期三。

sentences.en: Andrew, I wonder if you can take us back to the moment when you discovered that this pretty unimaginable thing had occurred.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁，我想请你带我们回到你发现这件几乎不可想象的事情发生的那一刻。

sentences.en: Ukrainian troops entering Russian territory and turning the basic equation of this war upside down.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰军队进入俄罗斯领土，彻底颠覆了这场战争的基本格局。

sentences.en: Well, the entire operation was shrouded in secrecy.
sentences.zh: 嗯，整个行动都笼罩在秘密之中。

sentences.en: So the first reports were actually from Russian social media posts, and everything was a little bit vague.
sentences.zh: 所以最初的报道实际上来自俄罗斯的社交媒体帖子，一切都还有点模糊。

sentences.en: We were seeing reports of fighting along the border, but nothing indicating the scale of what was to come.
sentences.zh: 我们看到了沿边境发生战斗的报道，但没有任何迹象表明即将发生的事情规模有多大。

sentences.en: The secret was very well guarded.
sentences.zh: 这个秘密保守得非常好。

sentences.en: It wasn't clear until the second day that this was more than a border skirmish, that this was a full Ukrainian military invasion of Russia,
sentences.zh: 直到第二天，人们才清楚这不仅仅是一场边境冲突，而是一场乌克兰对俄罗斯的全面军事入侵，

sentences.en: and that Ukraine had taken control of a rural area in the southwestern part of Russia.
sentences.zh: 而且乌克兰已经控制了俄罗斯西南部的一个农村地区。

sentences.en: So what do you do there in Kyiv, where I imagine you're absorbing this information, once you realize that such a major turning point in this conflict has just begun to unfold?
sentences.zh: 那么，当你在基辅，我想你当时正在消化这些信息，当你意识到这场冲突的一个重大转折点刚刚开始展开时，你是怎么做的？

sentences.en: Well, we decided to head out to the border region in northeastern Ukraine and have a look at how this appeared on the ground.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们决定前往乌克兰东北部的边境地区，看看实地情况如何。

sentences.en: And this required a little bit of logistics.
sentences.zh: 这需要一点后勤准备。

sentences.en: We used an armored car that the Bureau has.
sentences.zh: 我们使用了分社的一辆装甲车。

sentences.en: I don't think I knew that we had an armored car.
sentences.zh: 我想我之前都不知道我们有装甲车。

sentences.en: We do.
sentences.zh: 我们确实有。

sentences.en: And initially we were watching and talking to soldiers and officers about this incursion, and then also creeping forward toward the border to get a firsthand look.
sentences.zh: 起初，我们观察并与士兵和军官谈论这次入侵，然后也慢慢向前推进到边境，以获得第一手的观察。

sentences.en: And we drove, you know, over a very high plain where the road passes into Russia, and it's a very rural area of cornfields and country roads.
sentences.zh: 我们开车经过了一片非常高的平原，道路通往俄罗斯，那是一个非常乡村的地区，有玉米地和乡村公路。

sentences.en: And then ahead of us was the border, completely unguarded, seemingly deserted, at least from a distance.
sentences.zh: 然后我们前方就是边境，完全无人看守，看起来空无一人，至少从远处看是这样。

sentences.en: So this was a remarkable moment.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个非凡的时刻。

sentences.en: As somebody who covered Russia, the idea of the Russian border being open and deserted by the Russian military was really remarkable.
sentences.zh: 作为一个报道俄罗斯的人，俄罗斯边境敞开且被俄军遗弃的想法真的很不寻常。

sentences.en: And once you get inside, what are you seeing?
sentences.zh: 当你进入内部后，你看到了什么？

sentences.en: We got out of the car and looked around and saw really a tableau of destruction.
sentences.zh: 我们下了车，环顾四周，看到了一幅真正的毁灭景象。

sentences.en: This was a Russian administrative building, maybe three stories tall at one point before it was bombarded.
sentences.zh: 这是一座俄罗斯行政大楼，在被轰炸前可能有三层楼高。

sentences.en: Now sheet metal was just flapping in the wind.
sentences.zh: 现在金属板在风中拍打着。

sentences.en: All the windows were blown out.
sentences.zh: 所有的窗户都被震碎了。

sentences.en: And we looked around and there were craters in the ground from artillery and debris.
sentences.zh: 我们环顾四周，地上有炮击留下的弹坑和碎片。

sentences.en: Shells from a fight, a firefight, were tinkling underfoot when we walked.
sentences.zh: 当我们走动时，脚下发出交火留下的弹壳碰撞声。

sentences.en: And there were customs forms and other administrative documents blowing on the ground.
sentences.zh: 地上还有海关表格和其他行政文件在飘动。

sentences.en: And a little bit farther on, there was a sign over the road that said Russia.
sentences.zh: 再往前一点，路边有一个写着“俄罗斯”的牌子。

sentences.en: It was a very eerie scene.
sentences.zh: 那是一个非常诡异的场景。

sentences.en: And what we were looking at was the detritus of a lost battle to defend the Russian border.
sentences.zh: 我们所看到的是一场保卫俄罗斯边境的失败战斗留下的残骸。

sentences.en: So we walked around this site and we noticed some Ukrainian soldiers who were wearing surgical masks.
sentences.zh: 我们在现场走动，注意到一些戴着医用口罩的乌克兰士兵。

sentences.en: And it became clear that what we were seeing was a grim task by these soldiers of clearing the bodies of dead Russians from this building
sentences.zh: 很明显，我们看到的是这些士兵在执行一项严峻的任务，清理这座建筑里俄罗斯人的尸体，

sentences.en: that had been destroyed in the initial attack on the Russian border.
sentences.zh: 这些人在最初对俄罗斯边境的袭击中丧生。

sentences.en: We watched them load bodies and zip them into body bags.
sentences.zh: 我们看着他们装载尸体，并把它们装进尸袋。

sentences.en: And this was really, you know, a grim scene of just what a difficult fight and losing fight this had been for Russian border guards at this site.
sentences.zh: 这确实是一个严峻的场景，展示了俄罗斯边防军在这个地点经历了一场多么艰难且惨败的战斗。

sentences.en: This section of the border had likely been chosen in part because it was guarded by Russian conscript soldiers.
sentences.zh: 这段边境线之所以被选中，部分原因可能是因为它由俄罗斯义务兵把守。

sentences.en: And these are very green, inexperienced soldiers who've been drafted after high school.
sentences.zh: 这些都是非常稚嫩、缺乏经验的士兵，高中毕业后就被征召入伍了。

sentences.en: And in almost all cases that we know of, they retreated, abandoned their positions or they surrendered.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，在几乎所有情况下，他们都撤退了、放弃了阵地或者投降了。

sentences.en: There were small arms, cartridges, and there were sandbags in this location, firing positions.
sentences.zh: 在这个位置有轻武器、弹药筒和沙袋，还有射击阵地。

sentences.en: But there was no indication that they were expecting an army to come across the border at them.
sentences.zh: 但没有任何迹象表明他们预料到会有军队越过边境向他们进攻。

sentences.en: So after about 40 minutes, we decided it was time to go and got back in our armored car
sentences.zh: 所以在待了大约40分钟后，我们决定是时候离开了，于是回到了装甲车上，

sentences.en: and drove back into Ukraine, back into the relative safety of the cities far from the front line.
sentences.zh: 开车回到了乌克兰，回到了远离前线的城市相对安全的地方。

sentences.en: Once you return to Ukraine, Andrew, what do you end up learning about the scope of this operation?
sentences.zh: 安德鲁，当你回到乌克兰后，你最终了解到这次行动的规模了吗？

sentences.en: Clearly, you had just witnessed one place where Ukrainian troops had crossed the border
sentences.zh: 显然，你刚刚目睹了乌克兰军队越过边境的一个地点，

sentences.en: and clearly done a significant amount of damage to the Russian administrative border crossing.
sentences.zh: 并且显然对俄罗斯的行政边境检查站造成了相当大的破坏。

sentences.en: But how much territory was involved in this and how many Russian troops were killed or taken?
sentences.zh: 但是这涉及多少领土，有多少俄罗斯士兵被杀或被俘？

sentences.en: The ultimate scale of the invasion was significant.
sentences.zh: 这次入侵的最终规模是巨大的。

sentences.en: By some estimates, about 10,000 Ukrainian soldiers were involved.
sentences.zh: 据一些估计，大约有10,000名乌克兰士兵参与其中。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: This one border post was not the only target.
sentences.zh: 这个边境哨所并不是唯一的目标。

sentences.en: They crossed in multiple locations.
sentences.zh: 他们在多个地点越境。

sentences.en: And once they had breached the border, quickly fanned out on the highways and captured towns and villages.
sentences.zh: 一旦突破边境，他们迅速散开到高速公路上，占领了城镇和村庄。

sentences.en: Ultimately, by now, occupying about 400 square miles of Russian territory, around 120,000 Russian civilians were displaced.
sentences.zh: 最终，到目前为止，他们占领了约400平方英里的俄罗斯领土，约120,000名俄罗斯平民流离失所。

sentences.en: More thousands, although we don't know the precise number, are now under Ukrainian occupation.
sentences.zh: 还有数千人，虽然我们不知道确切数字，现在处于乌克兰的占领之下。

sentences.en: And the fighting has continued moving both deeper into Russia and also spreading out along the border to widen this area that's under Ukrainian control.
sentences.zh: 战斗仍在继续，既向俄罗斯腹地深入，也沿着边境蔓延，以扩大乌克兰控制的区域。

sentences.en: What you're describing in no way feels like a gesture or something that's meant to be fleeting, but clearly something longer term, this invasion of Russia.
sentences.zh: 你所描述的这场对俄罗斯的入侵，一点也不像是一种姿态或短暂的行为，显然是更长期的行动。

sentences.en: Do you have the sense, Andrew, that this kind of operation at this scale was allowed under the terms of the West's military aid to Ukraine?
sentences.zh: 安德鲁，你是否感觉到这种规模的行动是在西方对乌克兰军事援助的条款允许范围内的？

sentences.en: We've talked a lot about this on the show with you, with our colleagues who cover Russia, that it's been understood that Ukraine could not really use Western military equipment,
sentences.zh: 我们在节目中和你以及报道俄罗斯的同事们讨论过很多次，人们一直认为乌克兰不能真正使用西方的军事装备，

sentences.en: as it has done here, clearly, to go after Russia itself, with very few exceptions.
sentences.zh: 正如他们在这里所做的那样，显然，去攻击俄罗斯本土，极少数例外情况除外。

sentences.en: Well, the fact is, Zelensky has said he didn't tell the U.S.
sentences.zh: 事实是，泽连斯基说他没有提前告诉美国这次行动。

sentences.en: in advance of this operation.
sentences.zh: 他没有征求许可。

sentences.en: He didn't ask permission.
sentences.zh: 拜登政府的政策是避免升级。

sentences.en: The Biden administration's policy is to avoid escalation.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯是一个拥有核武器的国家，允许美国导弹、美国武器在俄罗斯境内使用是一个重大的步骤。

sentences.en: Russia is a nuclear-armed country, and to allow American missiles, American weapons to be used inside of Russia was a significant step.
sentences.zh: 但一旦乌克兰发起了这次行动，这次对俄罗斯的地面入侵，我们从德国人、美国人那里听到，在他们的评估中，这实际上，

sentences.en: But once Ukraine launched this operation, this ground invasion of Russia, we heard from the Germans, we heard from the Americans, that this was, in fact, in their assessment,
sentences.zh: 是在使用西方武器保卫乌克兰的范围内。

sentences.en: within the bounds of using Western weaponry to defend Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 此前有一个例外，即武器可以在边境地区用于防御目的，而这次行动就是从这个角度来解读的。

sentences.en: There had been an exception that weapons could be used in the border region for defensive purposes, and this was interpreted in that light.
sentences.zh: 有趣。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 那么，考虑到这一点，我们对乌克兰在这里的目标了解多少？他们进行如此冒险的入侵俄罗斯的目标是什么？

sentences.en: Well, with that in mind, what do we know about Ukraine's objective here, its goals, for undertaking such a risky invasion of Russia?
sentences.zh: 乌克兰政府最初没有明确表达任何目标，但很明显这有几个层面。

sentences.en: The Ukrainian government didn't initially articulate any goals, but it's clear there were several layers to this.
sentences.zh: 一个是战略和军事上的。

sentences.en: One was strategic and military.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰人想在俄罗斯最薄弱的地方进行打击，迫使俄罗斯将其军队和武器从乌克兰境内转移到保卫其俄罗斯境内的领土上。

sentences.en: The Ukrainians wanted to strike where Russia was weakest and force Russia to divert its troops and its weapons from inside Ukraine to defending its own territory inside Russia.
sentences.zh: 这是一种将战争带到俄罗斯的策略，通过这种方式，减轻他们在乌克兰东部为守住领土而进行殊死搏斗的士兵的压力。

sentences.en: It was a strategy of taking the war to Russia, and in this way, relieving pressure on their own soldiers who were fighting desperately in eastern Ukraine to hold territory.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，是为了加强乌克兰在主战场，也就是被俄罗斯占领的乌克兰境内的筹码。

sentences.en: So basically, to strengthen Ukraine's own hand on the main battlefield, which is Russian-occupied Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 还有什么？

sentences.en: What else?
sentences.zh: 你说这是多重动机的。

sentences.en: You said this is multi-motivational.
sentences.zh: 嗯，似乎还有一个更大的地缘政治目标，那就是加速战争的结束。

sentences.en: Well, there seemed to be another larger geopolitical goal, and this was a goal to hasten the end of the war.
sentences.zh: 有一种感觉，如果他们打击俄罗斯境内，如果他们占领领土，这将为可能的和平谈判提供筹码。

sentences.en: There was a sense that if they were to strike inside of Russia, if they were to capture territory, this would provide leverage in possible peace talks.
sentences.zh: 对，因为这是第一次，乌克兰拥有了俄罗斯想要的东西，而不是反过来。

sentences.en: Right, because for the first time, Ukraine has something that Russia wants, not the other way around.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 还有一个想法是，这可能会对俄罗斯的公众舆论产生影响，通过向俄罗斯人展示被占领、被攻击是什么感觉，

sentences.en: And there was also an idea that this could have an effect on public opinion in Russia, that by showing Russians what it's like to be occupied, what it's like to be attacked,
sentences.zh: 普京将无法再向他的社会展示在乌克兰的行动是一件遥远的事情，是一件即使他们过着正常生活也会继续下去的事情。

sentences.en: Putin could no longer present to his society the operation in Ukraine as something distant and something that would continue even as they live their ordinary lives.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 我们知道乌克兰以前也采取过这种方法，通过对俄罗斯社区甚至莫斯科的零星无人机袭击，将这场冲突的痛苦带给俄罗斯。

sentences.en: We know that Ukraine has pursued that approach before, bringing the pain of this conflict to Russia through sporadic drone attacks on Russian communities, even in Moscow.
sentences.zh: 但这似乎是迄今为止该策略中最雄心勃勃、最成功的一个版本，完全是另一个数量级。

sentences.en: But this seems by far the most ambitious and successful version of that tactic, a whole other order of magnitude.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 我交谈过的乌克兰人说，也许这就是结束战争所需要的，向俄罗斯人展示战争在乌克兰境内是什么样子。

sentences.en: Ukrainians I talked to said that maybe this is what would be needed to end the war, to show Russians what the war was like inside of Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 我采访了一位女士，她说只有当俄罗斯人听到在防空洞里听到孩子哭泣是什么感觉时，他们才会想要结束战争。

sentences.en: I spoke with one woman who said that only when the Russians hear what it's like to hear a child crying in a bomb shelter would they want an end to the war.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是乌克兰的情绪。

sentences.en: So this was the Ukrainian sentiment.
sentences.zh: 这是一次大胆的军事行动，将有助于他们的战争。

sentences.en: This was a bold military move that would help them in their war.
sentences.zh: 但这是一个悬而未决的问题，这是否会促使俄罗斯坐到谈判桌前，还是会给乌克兰带来俄罗斯报复带来的更多痛苦。

sentences.en: But it's an open question whether this will bring Russia to the bargaining table or just more pain to Ukraine in a Russian retaliation.
sentences.zh: 休息之后，安东·特罗亚诺夫斯基将为我们带来俄罗斯方面的故事。

sentences.en: After the break, Anton Troianovsky brings us the Russian side of the story.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我是Wena Liu。

sentences.en: I'm Wena Liu.
sentences.zh: 我编写《纽约时报》游戏中的拼图游戏之一——Connections。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢尝试捉弄你。

sentences.zh: 嗯，让我们从军事反应开始。

sentences.en: Well, let's start with the military response.
sentences.zh: 在那里，很明显俄罗斯对此完全没有准备。

sentences.zh: 与此同时，

sentences.en: Ukraine is obviously getting the opportunity to dig in, and this is increasingly looking like a longer-term occupation of Russian territory by Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 所以这并不是你所期望的任何国家在被入侵时会做出的那种大规模军事反应，更不用说一个

sentences.zh: 像俄罗斯这样痴迷于边境的国家了。

sentences.en: as obsessed with its borders as Russia is.
sentences.zh: 是的，两周过去了，这真的很令人震惊，

sentences.zh: 俄罗斯政府如何向俄罗斯人民解释这一现实，即他们目前，

sentences.en: letting Ukraine occupy all this Russian territory?
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们并没有真正试图解释，但这确实把我们带到了俄罗斯反应的政治媒体公关层面，这实际上一直被当作

sentences.en: Well, they're not really trying to explain it, but that does sort of bring us to the kind of political media PR aspect of the Russian response, which has been really to treat this
sentences.zh: 一场自然灾害，而不是这场战争的一部分。

sentences.en: as a natural disaster more than as part of this war.
sentences.zh: 一场自然灾害，而不是这场战争的一部分。

sentences.en: So...
sentences.zh: 那么……

sentences.en: Can you explain that?
sentences.zh: 你能解释一下吗？

sentences.en: How are they treating it like a natural disaster?
sentences.zh: 他们怎么会把它当作自然灾害来处理呢？

sentences.en: If you turned on the Russian TV news in the days after the invasion started, two weeks ago, you were seeing pictures of pallets of water being delivered to displaced people.
sentences.zh: 如果你在两周前，也就是入侵开始后的那几天打开俄罗斯电视新闻，你会看到运送给流离失所者的成托盘水的画面。

sentences.en: You were seeing footage of candlelight vigils around the country and people saying things like,
sentences.zh: 你会看到全国各地烛光守夜的镜头，人们说着这样的话：

sentences.en: Kursk, we are with you.
sentences.zh: 库尔斯克，我们与你同在。

sentences.en: But it was not cast as part of, or let alone a consequence, of Putin's invasion of Ukraine that started in February 2022.
sentences.zh: 但这并没有被描述为普京2022年2月发动的对乌克兰入侵的一部分，更不用说是其后果了。

sentences.en: So I think the choice has been made so far to just play this down.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，到目前为止，他们选择的策略就是淡化这件事。

sentences.en: You know, they're calling it the situation in the Kursk region on Russian TV.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在俄罗斯电视台上，他们称之为“库尔斯克地区的局势”。

sentences.en: So the strategy is kind of self-denial.
sentences.zh: 所以这种策略算是一种自我否认。

sentences.en: If Russia doesn't treat this like an invasion, it's not an invasion.
sentences.zh: 如果俄罗斯不把这当作入侵，那它就不是入侵。

sentences.en: A little bit reminds us of what Putin has said about invading Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 这有点让我们想起普京当初谈论入侵乌克兰时所说的话。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Special operation, not a full-scale invasion of a neighboring country.
sentences.zh: 特别军事行动，而不是对邻国的全面入侵。

sentences.en: Yeah, and remember,
sentences.zh: 没错，而且要记住，

sentences.en: Putin is the president of an autocracy in which there is basically no free media at this point.
sentences.zh: 普京是一个独裁政体的总统，目前那里基本上没有自由媒体。

sentences.en: So he does have the luxury, right, to take this kind of tack and does not have to think very much about short-term public pressure on his actions.
sentences.zh: 所以他确实有这种“奢侈”，对吧，可以采取这种策略，而不必过多考虑短期内公众对他行为的压力。

sentences.en: But while Putin hasn't responded forcefully yet, it doesn't mean he isn't planning something or it doesn't mean he won't still respond.
sentences.zh: 但虽然普京目前还没有做出强有力的回应，但这并不意味着他没有在筹划什么，也不意味着他以后不会做出回应。

sentences.en: Think back to last summer when the Prigozhin mutiny march on Moscow happened in June and two months later,
sentences.zh: 回想一下去年夏天，六月份发生了普里戈任的兵变进军莫斯科事件，两个月后，

sentences.en: Prigozhin's plane fell out of the sky in what we believe was a Kremlin assassination.
sentences.zh: 普里戈任的飞机从空中坠落，我们认为这是克里姆林宫的一次暗杀。

sentences.en: So there could still be a response that comes later, but his non-response or slow response so far does remind us of how Putin has in many ways been cautious
sentences.zh: 所以未来仍可能有回应，但他迄今为止的无回应或缓慢回应，确实提醒了我们，普京在很多方面一直很谨慎，

sentences.en: throughout the last two and a half years to not have this become a wider war.
sentences.zh: 在过去两年半的时间里，他一直小心翼翼，避免让这演变成一场更广泛的战争。

sentences.en: Understood.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Given Russia's response so far and understanding that that response may be delayed, how should we think about whether Ukraine is actually achieving its goals for this invasion,
sentences.zh: 鉴于俄罗斯迄今为止的回应，并且考虑到这种回应可能会延迟，我们应该如何看待乌克兰是否真的实现了这次入侵的目标，

sentences.en: diverting Russian troops from Ukraine, who in theory would rush back to protect Russia's borders, drawing Russia into peace talks with Ukraine, and finally bringing the pain
sentences.zh: 即从乌克兰调走俄罗斯军队（理论上他们会赶回保护俄罗斯边境），将俄罗斯拖入与乌克兰的和平谈判，并最终将这场战争的痛苦

sentences.en: of this war as deeply as possible into Russia itself.
sentences.zh: 尽可能深地带入俄罗斯本土。

sentences.en: So the jury's still out.
sentences.zh: 目前还难下定论。

sentences.en: On the attempt to draw Russian troops out of eastern Ukraine and over to Kursk, that does not seem to have worked so far.
sentences.zh: 关于试图将俄军从乌克兰东部引向库尔斯克的尝试，到目前为止似乎并不奏效。

sentences.en: We have reports of some Russian troops leaving, but not really that many, and we are seeing that Russia is still pushing ahead in the Donbass region in eastern Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了一些俄军撤离的报道，但数量并不多，而且我们看到俄罗斯仍在乌克兰东部的顿巴斯地区推进。

sentences.en: The fight there for the Ukrainians is really tough right now.
sentences.zh: 对乌克兰人来说，那里的战斗现在非常艰难。

sentences.en: We're not seeing the Russian pressure let up in eastern Ukraine, and on the contrary, we're actually seeing them taking more of Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 我们没有看到俄罗斯在乌克兰东部的压力减弱，相反，我们实际上看到他们占领了更多的乌克兰领土。

sentences.en: That seems very important because the entire assumption of this invasion would seem to be
sentences.zh: 这似乎非常重要，因为这次入侵的全部假设似乎是，

sentences.en: that Putin's response would have to be to protect Russian territory.
sentences.zh: 普京的回应必须是保护俄罗斯领土。

sentences.en: So far, that doesn't seem to be his overall imperative, and now you're suggesting that instead, he's using it as a chance to push further and further into Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，这似乎并不是他的首要任务，而你现在暗示，他反而利用这个机会进一步深入乌克兰。

sentences.en: That would seem like a Ukrainian miscalculation.
sentences.zh: 这看起来像是乌克兰的误判。

sentences.en: So we don't know what's going to happen going forward, but for now, that part of the calculation seems to not have come through.
sentences.zh: 所以我们不知道未来会发生什么，但就目前而言，计算中的那一部分似乎没有实现。

sentences.en: But then there's other aspects here.
sentences.zh: 但这里还有其他方面。

sentences.en: So on pressuring Russia to go into bona fide peace talks with Ukraine where Russia would be ready to move back from its maximalist aims, there we still have to see.
sentences.zh: 关于向俄罗斯施压，使其与乌克兰进行真正的和平谈判，即俄罗斯准备放弃其极端目标，这一点我们还有待观察。

sentences.en: I mean, for the first time,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是第一次，

sentences.en: Ukraine is holding
sentences.zh: 乌克兰占领了

sentences.en: Russian territory, and for the first time, you can now imagine a deal in which Ukraine pulls back troops in exchange from Russia pulling back troops.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯领土，现在你可以想象一种交易，即乌克兰撤军以换取俄罗斯撤军。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: So Ukraine absolutely has a new kind of leverage here.
sentences.zh: 所以乌克兰在这里绝对拥有了一种新的筹码。

sentences.en: The problem is that
sentences.zh: 问题在于，

sentences.en: Putin is not someone who likes the optics of folding under pressure.
sentences.zh: 普京不是那种喜欢在压力下屈服的人。

sentences.en: But there is one test case that we're watching closely.
sentences.zh: 但我们正在密切关注一个测试案例。

sentences.en: Our colleagues at the Washington Post have done some good reporting on this, and that is negotiations around both sides committing to not striking
sentences.zh: 我们在《华盛顿邮报》的同事对此做了一些很好的报道，那就是双方承诺不打击

sentences.en: each other's energy infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 对方能源基础设施的谈判。

sentences.en: There was supposed to be a round of talks about this potential deal this month after the Kursk incursion.
sentences.zh: 在库尔斯克入侵之后，本月本应有一轮关于这项潜在协议的会谈。

sentences.en: Russian officials have said, we don't see a point in negotiating with Ukraine for now.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯官员表示，我们认为目前与乌克兰谈判没有意义。

sentences.en: So they're not ruling it out entirely, but they're saying, for now, we won't talk.
sentences.zh: 所以他们并没有完全排除这种可能性，但他们说，目前我们不会谈。

sentences.en: So if this invasion was supposed to represent a potential major breakthrough in the peace talks with Russia, based on the evidence so far, that is not happening.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果这次入侵本应代表与俄罗斯和平谈判的潜在重大突破，那么根据目前的证据，这种情况并没有发生。

sentences.en: But what about that third prong of Ukraine's strategy,
sentences.zh: 但乌克兰战略的第三个方面又如何呢？

sentences.en: inflicting pain on the Russian people in their own country?
sentences.zh: 即给俄罗斯人民在本国境内造成痛苦？

sentences.en: That seems self-evidently to have already happened.
sentences.zh: 这似乎不言而喻地已经发生了。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: This is really a humiliation for Putin.
sentences.zh: 这对普京来说确实是一种羞辱。

sentences.en: That's clear.
sentences.zh: 这一点很清楚。

sentences.en: But at the same time, you have to remember that Ukraine occupies a few hundred square miles of territory right now.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，你必须记住，乌克兰目前只占领了几百平方英里的领土。

sentences.en: That's a very, very small sliver of the Kursk region.
sentences.zh: 那只是库尔斯克地区非常、非常小的一块碎片。

sentences.en: And obviously, microscopic, if you think about the six plus million square miles that Russia occupies on the globe.
sentences.zh: 显然，如果你考虑到俄罗斯在全球范围内占有的六百多万平方英里领土，这简直微不足道。

sentences.en: So,
sentences.zh: 所以，

sentences.en: Russians have become more worried, have become more anxious, but it's not a drastic, dramatic shift.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯人变得更加担心，更加焦虑，但这并不是一种剧烈的、戏剧性的转变。

sentences.en: Well, Anton, that makes me wonder if there's a universe where Ukraine pushes day after day, bridge after bridge, mile after mile, and starts to take so much Russian territory
sentences.zh: 嗯，安东，这让我怀疑是否存在这样一种情况：乌克兰日复一日、桥梁接桥梁、一英里接一英里地推进，开始占领如此多的俄罗斯领土，

sentences.zh: 以至于这个信息能以一种非常、非常响亮且难以忽视的方式传达给所有俄罗斯人民。

sentences.en: I mean, so one problem here is that there's another potential response you could see from a public in this kind of situation, which is the rally around the flag effect, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这里的一个问题是，在这种情况下，你可能会看到公众的另一种潜在反应，那就是“聚旗效应”，对吧？

sentences.en: That as Ukraine pushes forward, more and more Russians might actually become further energized to support

sentences.en: Putin's war.
sentences.zh: 普京的战争。

sentences.en: We haven't seen a ton of that yet, but that's certainly one other thing to watch.
sentences.zh: 我们还没有看到太多这种情况，但这无疑是另一件值得关注的事情。

sentences.en: The other question mark is at what point do Ukraine's
sentences.zh: 另一个问号是，乌克兰的

sentences.en: I think that that concern still clearly does exist in Western capitals.
sentences.zh: 我认为这种担忧在西方各国首都显然仍然存在。

sentences.en: The Biden administration obviously so far still hasn't allowed Ukraine to use long-range missiles to strike
sentences.zh: 拜登政府显然到目前为止仍然不允许乌克兰使用远程导弹打击

sentences.en: Russian territory beyond the immediate border areas.
sentences.zh: 边境直接区域以外的俄罗斯领土。

sentences.en: So we'll have to see about that, but certainly you now hear
sentences.zh: 所以我们还得拭目以待，但你现在肯定听到了

sentences.en: President Zelensky saying that
sentences.zh: 泽连斯基总统说，

sentences.zh: 普京过去两周的无动于衷表明，用泽连斯基的话说，俄罗斯有不可逾越的红线这种想法是天真的。

sentences.en: So it feels like at the moment two weeks into this invasion there are two let's call them fictions for lack of a better word guiding how everyone is seeing and responding to this
sentences.zh: 所以感觉在这次入侵两周后的当下，有两件——姑且称之为虚构吧，因为找不到更好的词——在引导着每个人如何看待和应对这次

sentences.en: military action by Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰的军事行动。

sentences.en: The first is that
sentences.zh: 第一点是，

sentences.en: Putin's acting as if this invasion never really happened at all and how long can he really keep that up?
sentences.zh: 普京表现得好像这次入侵从未发生过一样，他到底能维持多久？

sentences.en: And for Ukraine the alleged fiction here is that there really is a red line that they can't cross in bringing this war back to Russia and the Russian people without triggering
sentences.zh: 而对于乌克兰来说，这里所谓的虚构是，他们真的有一条不能逾越的红线，即在不引发

sentences.en: a wider conflict.
sentences.zh: 更广泛冲突的情况下将战争带回俄罗斯和俄罗斯人民身边。

sentences.en: So far
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，

sentences.en: Ukraine seems to be saying that that red line doesn't exist and we just
sentences.zh: 乌克兰似乎在说那条红线并不存在，我们只是

sentences.zh: 把这两个虚构的概念放在一起思考。

sentences.en: Well for one thing they show how unpredictable this war is just like who could have thought that we would be sitting here in August
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先，它们展示了这场战争是多么不可预测，就像谁能想到我们会在2024年8月

sentences.en: 2024 talking about a Ukrainian invasion onto Russian territory and talking about
sentences.zh: 坐在这里谈论乌克兰对俄罗斯领土的入侵，谈论

sentences.en: Putin and Putin doesn't seem to be all that concerned about it.
sentences.zh: 普京，而普京似乎对此并不怎么担心。

sentences.en: So you're seeing this competition between these two big almost guiding principles for these two men fighting this war.
sentences.zh: 所以你看到了这两位领导这场战争的人之间，在两个几乎是指导原则的大方向上的竞争。

sentences.en: Putin's constant signaling that he's ready to bear more costs to get what he wants.
sentences.zh: 普京不断发出信号，表明他准备承担更多代价来获得他想要的东西。

sentences.en: And Zelensky's showing us that he's willing to take risks and do the unexpected and take the fight to Russia and test what some thought would be
sentences.zh: 而泽连斯基向我们展示了他愿意冒险，做意想不到的事情，将战争带到俄罗斯，并测试一些人认为会是

sentences.en: Russia's red line.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯红线的东西。

sentences.en: And that just reminds us of how intractable this war is.
sentences.zh: 这提醒了我们这场战争是多么难以解决。

sentences.en: How two and a half years in people still don't understand how it ends or when it ends.
sentences.zh: 两年半过去了，人们仍然不明白它如何结束或何时结束。

sentences.en: Perhaps the invasion brings us closer to that or perhaps it extends it even more.
sentences.zh: 也许这次入侵让我们离结束更近了，或者也许它让战争延长了更多。

sentences.en: Well Anton thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，安东，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，

sentences.zh: 迈克尔。

sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。
